_meta.openai/widgetDescription: A model's backtest: interactive price chart with buy/sell arrows + trade log + win-rate/profit-factor stats.

description:
A trained model's backtest: trades, stats and the data for a cumulative-return chart.

    Takes a model's `stem` (from `get_deploy_result`, `one_shot` or `list_models`)
    and returns how it traded. In clients that render the openai/outputTemplate
    widget (ChatGPT) it shows an interactive chart; elsewhere the structured
    output carries the trades and stats a client can draw as a line chart of
    the cumulative return and a trade table.

    Args:
      stem: The model stem (e.g. "14_EURUSD_15min_Model_24") from `list_models` / `one_shot`.

    Returns:
      dict with: ok, stem, symbol, timeframe, stats {ret, wr, pf, n, mdd, sharpe},
      and trades [{type, entry_time, exit_time, entry_price, exit_price, pnl,
      pnl_pct, exit_reason, period}] (most recent ~200). exit_reason is one of
      TP / SL / close_only / signal / end. ret/mdd/wr are fractions; pnl_pct is percent.
name: get_model_chart
title: Show Backtest Chart (equity + trades)
